item.title: WPL 2026: RCB break their own record to win Final as Smriti Mandhana leads RCB to historic triumph
item.description: Royal Challengers Bengaluru scripted history in the WPL 2026 final by defeating Delhi Capitals by six wickets at Vadodara. Chasing a massive target of 204, RCB completed the highest successful run chase in WPL history.

item.title: US to influence oil market? Trump claims 68% of global oil controlled
item.description: US President Donald Trump claimed that the United States and Venezuela together control 68% of the world’s oil reserves. Speaking at the 74th National Prayer Breakfast, he said the US will utilize Venezuela’s oil and expand its energy business globally.

item.title: Gold price crashes on MCX amid profit booking and Dollar rise; Check price here
item.description: Gold and silver prices on MCX tumbled on Friday amid profit booking, weak global cues, and a stronger US dollar. April gold futures fell nearly ₹2,700 to ₹1,49,396 per 10 grams, while silver March contracts dropped ₹14,600 to ₹2,29,187 per kg.

item.title: Indian Markets start lower as investors await RBI policy decision; Full details
item.description: Indian equity markets opened lower on Friday, with Nifty50 at 25,594.35 and BSE Sensex at 83,203.83, as investors awaited the RBI Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) outcome. NTPC, Tata Steel, HDFC Bank, and Maruti were early losers, while Bajaj Finance and Kotak Bank gained

item.title: RBI keeps policy interest rates unchanged at 5.25%, maintains neutral stance; Full details here
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has kept the repo rate unchanged at 5.25%, maintaining a neutral monetary policy stance. The decision was taken unanimously by the RBI Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) under Governor Sanjay Malhotra.

item.title: Vijay gets no relief from Madras High Court in undisclosed income case
item.description: The Madras High Court dismissed actor Vijay’s plea challenging a ₹1.5 crore income tax penalty linked to alleged undisclosed earnings from the 2015 film Puli. The court upheld the Income Tax Department’s action, rejecting arguments that the order was time-barred.

item.title: Meghalaya: Illegal mine blast death toll crosses 18; Rescue operations underway
item.description: Rescue and relief operations were launched immediately after the explosion. According to the latest reports, 18 bodies have been recovered from the debris. There is a possibility of more bodies still trapped.

item.title: Malayalam Actor Maniyanpilla Raju arrested in hit-and-run case in Thiruvananthapuram
item.description: Raju appeared before the Museum Police on Friday where he was arrested. Police recorded his arrest and took him for a medical examination. Later he was granted bail from the Museum Police station.

item.title: RBI to tighten digital payment safety; Proposes Rs 25,000 compensation for fraud losses
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India has proposed compensating customers up to ₹25,000 for losses from small-value fraudulent digital transactions, alongside new draft guidelines on mis-selling, loan recovery practices, and liability in unauthorized banking transactions.

item.title: Delhi Horror: Biker falls into Jal Board pit in Janakpuri; Dies
item.description: The eyewitnesses said that no warning signs or barricades were there around the area under repair by the Delhi Jal Board. It raises serious concerns about safety measures at construction sites.
